sentences.s: 我今天晚点下班，省得明天早上手忙脚乱。
sentences.t: 我今天晚點下班，省得明天早上手忙腳亂。
sentences.en: Today I'm working a little late so as to avoid a rush in the morning.

sentences.s: 这个工人本来应该在中午十二点到达，但他被交通堵塞困住了几个小时。
sentences.t: 這個工人本來應該在中午十二點到達，但他被交通堵塞困住了幾個小時。
sentences.en: The handyman was supposed to arrive at twelve noon, but got stuck in a traffic jam for a few hours.

sentences.s: 现在我将把我的父母介绍给你。
sentences.t: 現在我將把我的父母介紹給你。
sentences.en: Now I will introduce you to my parents.

sentences.s: 你也许不会记得，而我永远不会忘记。
sentences.t: 你也許不會記得，而我永遠不會忘記。
sentences.en: You may well not remember, but I'll never forget it.

sentences.s: 那个工作几乎被完成了。
sentences.t: 那個工作幾乎被完成了。
sentences.en: That job is pretty much finished.
I don't want to have this fight.

这.m: (pronoun) this; these; (bound form) this; the (followed by a noun); (bound form) this; these (followed by a classifier) (in this sense, commonly pr. , esp. in Beijing); (coll.) this

把.m: to hold; to grasp; to hold a baby in position to help it urinate or defecate; handlebar; classifier: handful, bundle, bunch

是.m: to be (followed by substantives only); correct; right; true; (respectful acknowledgement of a command) very well; (adverb for emphatic assertion)

的.m: of; ~'s (possessive particle); (used after an attribute when it modifies a noun); (used at the end of a declarative sentence for emphasis); (used after a noun, verb or adjective to form a nominal expression, as in 皮革的 "one made of leather" or 跑堂儿的 "a waiter (literally, one who runs back and forth in a restaurant)" or 新的 "new one")

丈.m: measure of length, ten Chinese feet (3.3 m); to measure; husband; polite appellation for an older male

夫.m: husband; man; manual worker; conscripted laborer (old)

没.m: (negative prefix for verbs) have not; not; drowned; to end; to die

在.m: to exist; to be alive; (of sb or sth) to be (located) at; (used before a verb to indicate an action in progress)

今.m: now; the present time; current; contemporary

点.m: to touch briefly; to tap; to mark with a dot; to check off (on a list); to order (food etc); to select; to mention; to bring up (a topic or person)

班.m: surname Ban; team; class; grade; (military) squad; work shift

省.m: to save; to economize; to be frugal; to omit; to delete; to leave out; province; provincial capital

得.m: to obtain; to get; to gain; to catch (a disease)

明.m: Ming Dynasty (1368–1644); surname Ming; Ming (c. 2000 BC), fourth of the legendary Flame Emperors, 炎帝 descended from Shennong 神农 Farmer God; bright

早.m: early; morning; Good morning!; long ago

上.m: used in 上声; (bound form) up; upper; above; previous; first (of multiple parts); to climb; to get onto; to go up

手.m: hand; (formal) to hold; person engaged in certain types of work; person skilled in certain types of work

忙.m: busy; hurriedly; to hurry; to rush

脚.m: foot; leg (of an animal or an object); base (of an object); classifier for kicks

乱.m: in confusion or disorder; in a confused state of mind; disorder; upheaval

个.m: used in 自个儿; (classifier used before a noun that has no specific classifier); (bound form) individual

本.m: (bound form) root; stem; (bound form) origin; source; (bound form) one's own; this; (bound form) this; the current (year etc)

来.m: to come; (used as a substitute for a more specific verb); hither (directional complement for motion toward the speaker, as in 回来); ever since (as in 自古以来)

应.m: surname Ying; to agree (to do sth); should; ought to

该.m: should; ought to; probably; must be

中.m: (bound form) China; Chinese; surname Zhong; within; among; in; middle; center

午.m: 7th earthly branch: 11 a.m.-1 p.m., noon, 5th solar month (6th June-6th July), year of the Horse; ancient Chinese compass point: 180° (south)

到.m: to reach; to arrive; to leave for; to go to; to (a place); until (a time); up to (a point); (verb complement indicating arriving at a place or reaching a point)

达.m: surname Da; to attain; to reach; to amount to

但.m: but; yet; however; still; merely; only; just

他.m: (third-person singular) (since the early 20th century, usu. male) he; him; his; (bound form) other; another; some other (as in 他日 and 他人)

被.m: quilt; to cover (with); (literary) to suffer (a misfortune); used to indicate passive voice (placed before the doer of the action like "by" in English passive-voice sentences, or, if the doer is not mentioned, before the verb)

交.m: to hand over; to deliver; to pay (money); to turn over; to make friends; (of lines) to intersect

通.m: to go through; to know well; (suffix) expert; to connect

堵.m: to block up (a road, pipe etc); to stop up (a hole); (fig.) (of a person) choked up with anxiety or stress; wall (literary)

塞.m: to plug; to stop up; to stuff in; (bound form) a stopper; a cork; (bound form) strategic stronghold; (bound form) to block; to obstruct

困.m: to trap; to surround; hard-pressed; stranded

住.m: to live; to reside; to stay; to stop; to cease; (result complement indicating firmness or a stable achieved state)

了.m: (completed action marker); (modal particle indicating change of state, situation now); (modal particle intensifying preceding clause); to finish

几.m: small table; (literary) almost; how many; how much; several; a few

时.m: surname Shi; (bound form) time; hour; period; season; (after a numeral) o'clock; hour(s); (after a verb phrase or clause) when; while

将.m: will; shall; to use; to take

父.m: (bound form) father; (bound form) male relative of father's generation (as in 伯父); (computing) (bound form) parent-

母.m: mother; elderly female relative; origin; source

介.m: to introduce; to lie between; between; shell

绍.m: surname Shao; to continue; to carry on

给.m: to; for; for the benefit of; to give

你.m: you (informal, as opposed to courteous 您); you (Note: In Taiwan, 妳 is used to address females, but in mainland China, it is not commonly used. Instead, 你 is used to address both males and females.)

书.m: abbr. for 书经; book; letter; document

好.m: good; appropriate; proper; all right!; (before a verb) easy to

厚.m: thick; deep or profound; kind; generous

也.m: surname Ye; also; too; as well; (not ...) either; (used after a verbal or nominal expression X to indicate that X is an extreme or unexpected case) even (X); (literary) particle having functions similar to 啊

许.m: surname Xu; to allow; to permit; to promise

不.m: no; not so; (bound form) not; un-

会.m: can; to have the skill; to know how to; to be likely to; to be sure to; to meet; to get together; meeting; gathering

记.m: to record; to note; to memorize; to remember

而.m: and; as well as; and so; but (not)

远.m: far; distant; remote; (intensifier in a comparison) by far

忘.m: to forget; to overlook; to neglect

那.m: surname Na; surname Nuo; (specifier) that; the; those (colloquial pr. ); (pronoun) that (referring to persons, things or situations)

作.m: (bound form) worker; (bound form) workshop; (slang) troublesome; high-maintenance (person); to do; to engage in

乎.m: (classical particle similar to 于) in; at; from; because

完.m: to finish; to be over; whole; complete

成.m: surname Cheng; short name for Chengdu 成都; to succeed; to finish

想.m: to think (about); to think of; to devise; to think (that); to believe (that); to desire; to want (to)

打.m: (loanword) dozen; to hit; to strike; to fight; (in many expressions) a semantically light transitive verb used with various objects to form expressions with a wide range of meanings, e.g. 打伞 "to hold an umbrella", 打电话 "to make a phone call", 打针 "to get an injection"

王.m: surname Wang; king or monarch; best or strongest of its type; grand

又.m: (once) again; also; both... and...; and yet

唱.m: to sing; to call loudly; to chant

起.m: to rise; to raise; to get up; to set out

俩.m: two (colloquial equivalent of 两个); both; some; used in 伎俩

要.m: (bound form) to demand; to coerce; to want; to need; to ask for; will; shall; about to; need to; should

一.m: one; single; a (article); as soon as
